visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Pembroke Welsh Corgis with orange and white coats stand on a paved road surface next to a dark gray minivan with its side door open. The dogs face away from the camera, their short tails wagging vigorously. Inside the vehicle, a child is visible sitting on a seat in a seated posture. (2) A young boy wearing a dark t-shirt and shorts climbs out of the van carrying a black patterned backpack. A woman dressed in a black shirt, jeans, and a sun hat stands nearby, looking at a mobile device. The dogs jump around the boy's feet with wide-open mouths and excited body language. (3) The scene moves to a storefront area with tiled flooring and numerous green plastic crates filled with round yellow fruits. The dogs follow the people closely, circling their legs and leaping into the air. The dogs' bodies move in rapid, jerky motions as they look upwards toward the woman's face. (4) A man's hand reaches into the frame to pet the dogs on their heads and necks. In the background, an older man in a light-colored polo shirt and dark trousers stands near a doorway next to an electric fan. The dogs continue their active physical engagement with the humans, wagging tails constantly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a heartwarming and high-energy moment where two family Corgis excitedly welcome a young boy home as he exits a minivan. The intent is to showcase the intense bond and joy between pets and their human family members, utilizing both the visual of wagging tails/jumping and the audio of frantic barking to convey pure happiness.
